note: Pretrial record of Commonwealth of Virginia v. Naresh Bhatt, Prince William County Circuit Court, before Judge Kimberly A. Irving. No trial testimony yet — the jury trial is set to begin the week of Oct. 5, 2026. Everything below is drawn from court filings and attributed reporting. The prosecution's evidence is described as allegation until a jury weighs it; Bhatt has pleaded not guilty.

pretrial.event: Mamta Kafle Bhatt, a 28-year-old nurse in Manassas Park, Virginia, is last seen in late July 2024. Investigators later say her phone was operational until about July 29, then went to voicemail, and that she stopped using her accounts entirely — she has never been found.

sources.outlet: Prince William Times — substantial evidence of blood led to arrest
WTOP — two years after she disappeared, husband's murder trial nears

pretrial.event: Naresh Bhatt is arrested at the couple's Manassas Park home and initially charged with one felony count of concealing a dead body. Police say they found significant pooled blood in the home. He is held without bond.

sources.outlet: Prince William Times — substantial evidence of blood led to arrest

pretrial.event: A judge denies Bhatt bond a second time after prosecutors lay out more evidence: forensic blood testing indicating injuries no one could survive, a cadaver dog alerting in the bedroom and bathroom, and surveillance of Bhatt buying knives and cleaning supplies and discarding bags in dumpsters. The defense argues the state has no body and that Mamta was visiting family amid a separation.

sources.outlet: WUSA9 — Naresh Bhatt denied bond a second time
CNN — husband denied bond in Mamta Kafle Bhatt case

pretrial.event: A grand jury indicts Bhatt on first-degree murder and defilement of a dead human body, adding to the concealment charge. A trial date is set for 2025.

sources.outlet: InsideNova — what's next in the Mamta Kafle Bhatt case
WTOP — two years after she disappeared, husband's murder trial nears

pretrial.event: The trial, then set for September 2025, is continued to October 2026. The defense says it needs time to review more than 1.5 terabytes of digital evidence delivered through a limited online system that took days to download; Judge Irving calls the situation mind-blowing.

sources.outlet: WJLA/ABC7 — trial delayed over digital evidence
InsideNova — murder trial delayed in mind-blowing development

pretrial.event: A closed hearing is set after a new forensic report: a handheld power saw taken from the home is found to carry human hairs and hair fragments, referred for nuclear DNA testing. Prosecutors allege the evidence points to a dismemberment; the defense contests how the material was handled.

sources.outlet: WJLA/ABC7 — closed hearing as new forensic evidence emerges

pretrial.event: Ahead of the October trial, the court orders about 300 prospective jurors summoned — several times the usual number — and declines to mail advance juror questionnaires, agreeing with the defense that they might prompt residents to research the heavily covered case. The trial is expected to run about seven weeks.
